interest: Provides rare SCAP evaluations of Japan's first female Diet members and legislative records founding the National Diet Library.
keywords: Special Committee on Irregular Property Transactions
overview: This file contains U.S. State Department despatches, SCAP Government Section memoranda, operational reports, and legislative texts from December 1946 to March 1948 documenting the reorganization and early operations of the Japanese National Diet under the postwar Constitution. Key topics include Far Eastern Commission oversight of implementing legislation, an in-depth assessment of the activities and committee performance of Japan's first female Diet members, the evolution of standing committees and Diet-Cabinet relations, and investigations by the Special Committee on Irregular Property Transactions. The collection also features a complete legislative summary of bills introduced during the First National Diet and statutory records detailing the American-assisted creation of the National Diet Library.
